[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Task dependency links: one Depends-On line, a vault-wide [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Ctrl+Shift+P picker, and live chips[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A task's prerequisites live as plain task dependency links on one [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]managed `⛓️ **DEPENDS ON:**` first-child line. That line is the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]source of truth, and the `\[dependsOn::]` / `\[id::]` fields are [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]derived from it. Ctrl+Shift+P adds and removes prerequisites by [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]fuzzy-searching every open task in the vault. bob-ledger-tools [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]draws each link as a live status chip. The vault no longer uses [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]transcluded dependency bullets. The glossary, docs, and decision [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]records describe the new contract.[/#D7D7AF]
